name: Transpact Enterprises Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2013, Transpact Enterprises 
Ltd deals in investment portfolio, Investment advisory, Corporate funding, Market consulting, for various clients[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) TEL operates in shares, securities, commodities, currencies, derivatives, insurance, and related services as a broker, underwriter, portfolio manager, investment advisor, and wealth manager.
b) The company also provides consulting and advisory services on corporate, financial, and commercial matters, including management consulting, debt structuring, debt advisory, and project appraisals.

cons: Stock is trading at 12.8 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -16.0%
Company has a low return on equity of -9.90% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 456 days.
Working capital days have increased from 584 days to 1,551 days
